title: The Toll Keeper
text: A bridge of black stone spans nothing, and on it squats a hunched keeper with a wooden bowl, its face lost in a hood. It names a price in a voice like grinding millstones. Bones lie below the bridge, far below, in the dark.

outcomes.text: The coins ring in the bowl and the keeper steps aside, humming.

options.label: The wisest offers a riddle instead.

outcomes.text: The keeper thinks for a long while, then laughs, and lets you pass for the pleasure of it.
It answers at once, and asks one back. Nobody knows it.

options.label: Shove it off its own bridge.

outcomes.text: It does not go over easily.
